_comment: Where the generated site points when it sends a reader to the code, and how it presents itself to crawlers. Kept out of build.py so moving the repository or going public is one edit here.
_indexable: False while this is a prototype: every page gets noindex and robots.txt disallows everything. Set true only when this is the real public site, and check base_url is where it actually lives first.
_base_url: Where the site is actually served. Not where it may live one day: a card or a sitemap pointing at a host that does not serve the page is worse than neither.
